title: inula scaberrima
intro: Inula scaberrima, commonly known as the globe artichoke, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. The globe artichoke has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestion. Its therapeutic actions include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and hepatoprotective effects, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Inula scaberrima include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
